title: Harmonize table row focus, density tokens, and chart legend keyboard affordances for accessibility certification
creator: Maya Chen
description: Scope: Consolidate focus styles and density token usage across interactive table rows, list-like tables, and chart legends to meet keyboard navigation and contrast requirements for accessibility certification. This includes token mapping (focus ring, outline, spacing), implementation guidance for table row focus vs cell focus patterns, keyboard order for chart legends and data point tooltips, and verification steps for high-contrast themes. Deliverables: updated token mapping doc, Figma component updates, implementation notes for engineers, and a compliance checklist for the VPAT submission.
acceptance_criteria: All interactive table variations (default, dense, compact) have consistent row-focus visuals that meet 3:1 contrast for focus indicators and 4.5:1 for text-on-focus as applicable.
Density tokens are documented and a migration mapping exists from legacy spacing tokens to new density tokens for table rows and cells.
Chart legend items are reachable via keyboard (Tab/Shift+Tab) and have clear focus states; focus order is documented and validated with screen reader narration notes.
A VPAT checklist entry and supporting screenshots (regular and high-contrast) are prepared and linked for the certification package.
Design sign-off and engineering implementation plan (PR link and estimated rollout) are attached and approved.
QA regression checklist runs successfully in cross-browser matrix (Chrome, Safari, Firefox) and in high-contrast mode.
No outstanding accessibility-blocking issues remain (critical or high severity) before release window.
Documentation for developers includes code snippets, semantic role recommendations (aria-rowindex/aria-selected), and guidance for preserving keyboard focus when rows are updated via JS.
All related Figma components have token variables bound and a migrations note for teams consuming the library.
